description: Use when an agent has to decide whether a wallet can pay before building a transaction: the native coin balance (ETH, MATIC...) of any address on Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum or Optimism, returned both as wei (exact integer string) and as ether, with the chain it was read on. Do not use for token balances (/v1/evm/erc20-balance) or for a whole-wallet view (/v1/evm/portfolio). Flat price, no rate limits, no API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

chain.description: base | ethereum | polygon | arbitrum | optimism. Defaults to base.

name: evm_balance
title: EVM native balance
